rationale: Stable v1.82.0 commit eb172115f3b90568d22a8b99dc947dd66cf2b409 already has device information, Summary settings, markers and editor Properties. This mixed task improves those existing interfaces; quarter-turn/contact and owned-availability refinements supplement beta #1070/#1026. The net result is a stable UI fix, with no new large workflow or persisted schema.

summary.ru: Карточка устройства и настройки сводки приведены к общему виду; выключение и недоступность показаны раздельно, свойства адаптируются к ширине карточки.
summary.en: Device information and Summary settings share a consistent appearance; Off and Unavailable are distinct, and Properties adapts to card width.
